claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive family for ClassFeatureMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Expertise is a permanent, one-time proficiency upgrade with no activation cost, no use-count resource, and no rest reset. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires all three of those fields. Forcing this into 'activation' would produce a dishonest trace (no quota consumed, no resource pool, no rest window).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose two of your skill proficiencies with which you lack Expertise. You gain Expertise in those skills.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_proficiency variant of ClassFeatureEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom 'grant_proficiency' exists in the taxonomy but is absent from the ClassFeatureEffect union (which only has grant_extra_action and heal_hp). Expertise specifically grants double-proficiency (Expertise) on chosen skills, which maps to grant_proficiency with a subtype or modifier indicating expertise-level.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain Expertise in those skills. [Expertise = proficiency bonus doubled on those skill checks]
